description: Advisory completeness checks for callbacks returned by Clipflip's public VAST tester sample. Nonempty creative and event path slots and the generated v query field are checked. Issued identifiers, accepted events, ord semantics, server rejection policy and delivery remain outside this profile.

params.name: creative_path
params.description: The public sample emits a nonempty opaque creative path slot. This warning checks template completeness and does not establish an issued-ID format or server rejection rule.
params.fix_hint: Preserve the generated creative path component from the original callback.

params.name: event_path
params.description: The public sample emits a nonempty event path component. Event values remain open; no closed event list or VAST mapping is imposed.
params.fix_hint: Preserve the generated event path component from the original callback.

params.name: v
params.description: All reviewed impression, event, click and error callbacks retain a nonempty v query field. Presence is observed producer-template completeness, not a vendor mandatory-field or delivery guarantee. No version enumeration is inferred.
params.fix_hint: Preserve the original generated v field.
